newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Filinvest down 9.30 pct on swap news.
newsitem.headline: Filinvest down 9.30 pct on swap news.

text.p: Filinvest Development Corp dipped by 80 centavos, or 9.30 percent, to 7.80 pesos on news that parent Filinvest Land Inc is undertaking a shares for assets swap with its subsidiaries, FDC and Filinvest Alabang Inc, brokers said.
On Monday, Filinvest Land's board of directors approved a deal under which land owned by FDC and Filinvest Alabang will be exchanged for unissued Filinvest Land shares.
"When a company undertakes a share swap, more shares are issued into the market, and this dilutes the earnings per share," said Cilette Liboro, Citisecurities Inc research head.
Filinvest Land shares also dropped by 50 centavos to 8.50 pesos in late trade.
A total of 3.99 million Filinvest Development shares changed hands late in the session.
